connector.name: Job Search MCP
connector.registryDescription: Claude searches real job boards, scores each job 0-100 for fit, and shows a ranked board.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package job-search-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the servation account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: JOB_SEARCH_MCP_DATA
env.description: Optional override for the per-user data file path (defaults to ~/.job-search-mcp/jobs.json).

env.name: LINKEDIN_LI_AT
env.description: Optional: your logged-in LinkedIn li_at cookie, for richer/Premium LinkedIn data instead of guest mode. Against LinkedIn's ToS; see README.

env.name: LINKEDIN_JSESSIONID
env.description: Optional: your logged-in LinkedIn JSESSIONID cookie, paired with LINKEDIN_LI_AT for Premium mode.
